self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 Echo: Normal/Charged Attack hits have a 50% chance (CD 8s) to fire a Bolt of Perception dealing 360% ATK DMG, which can bounce to up to 4 additional opponents; modeled as a supplementary hit on the primary target — its own rotation target (weapon/normalExtraHit + weapon/chargedExtraHit), weight = how many times it procs; physical, scales with ATK and CRIT only, no DMG% bonuses (bounce DMG to other targets not modeled).

en.flavor: A dim black glaze pearl that is said to have the power to read the purity of one's heart.

refinements.1: Normal and Charged Attacks have a 50% chance to fire a Bolt of Perception, dealing <r>240%</r> ATK as DMG. This bolt can bounce between opponents a maximum of 4 times. This effect can occur once every <r>12</r>s.
refinements.2: Normal and Charged Attacks have a 50% chance to fire a Bolt of Perception, dealing <r>270%</r> ATK as DMG. This bolt can bounce between opponents a maximum of 4 times. This effect can occur once every <r>11</r>s.
refinements.3: Normal and Charged Attacks have a 50% chance to fire a Bolt of Perception, dealing <r>300%</r> ATK as DMG. This bolt can bounce between opponents a maximum of 4 times. This effect can occur once every <r>10</r>s.
refinements.4: Normal and Charged Attacks have a 50% chance to fire a Bolt of Perception, dealing <r>330%</r> ATK as DMG. This bolt can bounce between opponents a maximum of 4 times. This effect can occur once every <r>9</r>s.
refinements.5: Normal and Charged Attacks have a 50% chance to fire a Bolt of Perception, dealing <r>360%</r> ATK as DMG. This bolt can bounce between opponents a maximum of 4 times. This effect can occur once every <r>8</r>s.

fr.flavor: Un orbe en verre sombre qui aurait le pouvoir de voir à travers le cœur des gens et de le purifier.
